title: Atlas Board Series
description: Four reference-linked pastry boards documenting internal structure with consistent catalog rigor.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the neutral background, specimen spacing, and cut-face lighting. Images 02-04 preserve that atlas board system while swapping pastry families from laminated dough to choux and glazed entremets.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-atlas-board-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
